message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: a party secretary (王某) received money from a real estate developer (郑某甲) during construction of a new village, using his position. This is classic bribery (受贿). Since he is a party secretary, a state functionary (国家工作人员). The examples: For non-state staff receiving bribe, they used "非国家工作人员受贿". For state staff, they used "受贿". Also sometimes "滥用职权" if also abusing authority. Here he just received money, no mention of abusing power beyond receiving. So crime: 受贿. Possibly also "滥用职权" if he used his position to facilitate? The facts: He used his position to receive bribes, but not necessarily to abuse authority. The typical charge: 受贿. So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
